sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2020. An Atlas of Nigerian Languages, ed. IV. Cambridge: Kay Williamson Educational Foundation. Entry 450 'Ubaghara cluster'.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Entry gives location (Cross River State, Akamkpa LGA), 30,000 (1985 UBS), classification (Upper Cross: Central: North-South), the five dialects and 'New Testament draft being revised (UBS 1989)'. It carries NO reference/sources line at all, i.e. Blench lists no description of Ubaghara.
